name: @trekmail/mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for TrekMail. Exposes 228 agent tools covering domains, DNS, mailboxes and webmail preferences, password-free mail-client setup, delegated shared-mailbox IMAP/SMTP discovery and lifecycle, aliases, forwarding, mail filters, auto-reply, sieve, migrations, SMTP routing, tickets, billing, spam stats, email verification, Cloudflare DNS, Drive, signatures, the full webmail surface, and connected Gmail/Outlook/IMAP accounts.
author: TrekGuider Inc.
